info.name: 🚗 EthioCars API — Complete Collection
info.description:
All 15 backend API endpoints for EthioCars.

🔑 SETUP:
1. Go to the Variables tab of this collection
2. Set 'firebase_token' to your Firebase ID Token
3. Set 'user_uid' to your Firebase User UID

💡 HOW TO GET YOUR TOKEN:
Open your app in browser → DevTools Console → Run:
(await firebase.auth().currentUser.getIdToken())

Tokens expire after 1 hour. Refresh when needed.

request.description:
Health check endpoint. Also used to wake the Render server from cold sleep.

No auth required.

Expected response:
{
  "status": "ok",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-23T..."
}

Tests if the server can connect to Cloudflare R2.

No auth required.

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Cloudflare R2 is connected and authenticated."
}

Uploads a listing image directly to Cloudflare R2.

In Postman: Body tab → select 'binary' → choose a JPG file.

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "publicUrl": "https://pub-26cca...r2.dev/listings/.../image1.jpg",
  "key": "listings/.../image1.jpg",
  "bucket": "ethiocars-images"
}

Uploads a payment screenshot to the payment-proofs R2 bucket.

In Postman: Body tab → select 'binary' → choose a JPG file.

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "publicUrl": "https://pub-241e6...r2.dev/payments/.../proof.jpg",
  "key": "payments/.../proof.jpg",
  "bucket": "payment-proofs"
}

Generates a presigned URL for direct browser-to-R2 upload.

The response contains an uploadUrl (temporary, expires in 5 minutes) and a publicUrl (permanent CDN link).

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "uploadUrl": "https://...r2.cloudflarestorage.com/...?X-Amz-...",
  "publicUrl": "https://pub-26cca...r2.dev/listings/...",
  "key": "listings/...",
  "bucket": "ethiocars-images"
}

request.description:
Creates a new car listing in Firestore.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: The entire listing object MUST be wrapped inside a "listing" key.
If you send fields at root level, you get 400 "Listing data required".

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "id": "postman-test-001"
}

Deletes a listing you own. Also cleans up R2 images.

⚠️ The listing ID goes in the QUERY PARAM (?id=xxx), NOT in the body.
⚠️ Your token's UID must match the listing's ownerId, or you must be an admin.

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Listing safely deleted"
}

Returns all listings (max 100, ordered by createdAt desc).

Requires admin role.

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "listings": [ ... ]
}

query.description: Options: all, approved, pending, sold, rejected, pending_payment_verification

request.description:
Returns listings filtered by status.

Valid status values: all, approved, pending, sold, rejected, pending_payment_verification

Requires admin role.

Updates any fields on a listing.

⚠️ CRITICAL: The listing ID must be IN THE URL PATH, not in the body.
✅ /api/admin/listings/abc123
❌ /api/admin/listings/     ← 404!
❌ /api/admin/listings      ← 404!

Requires admin role.

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Listing updated successfully"
}

Permanently deletes a listing + cleans up R2 images + payment proofs.

⚠️ CRITICAL: The listing ID must be IN THE URL PATH.
✅ /api/admin/listings/abc123
❌ /api/admin/listings/     ← 404!

Requires admin role.

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Listing safely deleted"
}

Verifies or rejects a payment.

status options: "verified" or "rejected"

When verified:
- Payment status → verified
- Listing status → approved, featured: true

When rejected:
- R2 images are deleted
- Listing status → payment_rejected → rejected (after 3 min)

Requires admin role.

Expected response:
{ "success": true }

Sends a push notification to a specific user when they receive a chat message.

Expected response:
{
  "success": true,
  "sent": true,
  "devicesNotified": 1
}
